scope: Independent manufactured Kirchhoff–Love shell check for the skew Nitsche sign, whole-chain endpoint-work rows with h weighting, and two-active-side trace quotient in Eqs. (21)–(29). Two coplanar, nonmatching cubic carriers sample an interior quadratic cut of a flat rectangle. An orthogonal T pair checks the one-sided material-edge/interior rule with a separately manufactured receiving line load. These are local manufactured models.
reference_loading: Independent external loading from the unintegrated exact bending boundary work (Q mu) dot grad(test) - div(Q) dot mu times test plus div(div(Q)) body term. Six exact corner displacements fix the rigid-body gauge; none are at interface endpoints.
orthogonal_T_reference_displacement: u_x=.001*(.4*x+.3*y); u_y=-.0002*y; w=.002*((x+a*x^4)*y+.18*y^2) on each local shell. The receiver is uncut and rotates 90 degrees about x. The manufactured line load applies the physical flux of the exact web using unintegrated trace work on the receiver, then compares the coupled solution to the same exact displacement.
retained_quadrature: 12-point Gauss quadrature in each longitudinal knot span and each retained transverse interval.
